') center center/cover no-repeat;filter:saturate(.87);opacity:1}
.wrap{position:relative;z-index:1}
.brand-banner.master-brand{background:linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(27,37,46,.90),rgba(19,29,38,.94));-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);backdrop-filter:blur(16px)}
.p5-si-card,.card,.match-center,.leaderboard-card,.stage1-controls,.master-stats .stat,.roster-registration-list{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(38,51,63,.79),rgba(20,31,41,.79))!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(15px) saturate(105%);backdrop-filter:blur(15px) saturate(105%);border-color:rgba(180,189,189,.26)!important;box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(3,7,11,.17)}
/* The Win VS Win scoreboard is a clean translucent graphic, not a photograph. */
.club-board{background:linear-gradient(125deg,rgba(23,35,43,.91),rgba(27,37,43,.89) 50%,rgba(22,33,42,.92))!important;box-shadow:0 10px 27px #0003}
.board-inner{padding-top:4px}
/* One compact round line, and the full history stays available on demand. */
.rounds-compact{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;margin:11px 0 6px;padding:9px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(193,190,181,.18)}
.rounds-compact>span{color:#d9bb93;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.035em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rounds-compact>span em{font-weight:400;font-style:normal;color:#a7b7c3;letter-spacing:0}
.rounds-toggle{border:1px solid rgba(208,177,134,.30);background:rgba(21,31,40,.4);color:#e1c7a8;font-size:10px;padding:7px 10px;white-space:nowrap;min-height:33px}
.rounds-drawer{margin:10px 0 12px;padding:11px;border:1px solid rgba(186,172,153,.25);border-radius:11px;background:rgba(8,18,27,.67)}
.rounds-drawer[hidden]{display:none!important}
.rounds-drawer-head{font-size:10px;color:#dbbf9c;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.11em;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px}
.rounds-drawer-head span{font-size:9px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0;color:#a8b6bf}
.match-center .round-selector{max-height:105px;overflow:auto;padding:0 0 8px}
.match-center .round-match-strip{margin-top:11px}
.round-overview{margin:6px 0 10px}
/* Pair result flow. Physical court is only a compact routing tag. */
.match-center-head h2{font-size:18px}
.court-header>strong{font-size:10px;color:#bfc9ce;letter-spacing:.12em}
.court-status.mini-court{padding:5px 8px;min-width:30px;text-align:center;border:1px solid rgba(217,188,147,.55);color:#f4d6a8;background:rgba(28,34,38,.70);font-size:11px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.04em;border-radius:7px}
.match-center .court{background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(35,49,59,.75),rgba(19,33,44,.77))!important;border:1px solid rgba(173,149,115,.59)!important}
.match-center .court-complete{min-height:39px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.045em}
.result-review-slot:empty{display:none}
.score-review{margin-top:11px;padding:11px;border:1px solid rgba(213,180,132,.59);border-radius:9px;background:rgba(13,25,34,.96);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:11px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.score-review>span{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#cbb28d;font-weight:750;line-height:1.5;flex:1 1 145px}
.score-review strong{display:block;color:#f0eadf;letter-spacing:0;font-size:11px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin-top:4px}
.score-review>div{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center}
.score-review button{font-size:10px;padding:8px 10px;min-height:34px}
/* Master-inspired nested Menu & Settings: tap the section, then the action. */
.global-dock #mainMenu{position:relative;min-width:182px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,rgba(37,48,57,.92),rgba(20,29,38,.95));border:1px solid rgba(191,173,145,.38);border-radius:12px;z-index:21}
.global-dock #mainMenu>summary{font-size:12px;padding:11px 14px;text-align:center;color:#f4e7d5;min-width:182px}
.global-dock #mainMenu[open]>summary{color:#e7c59b}
.global-dock .menu-grid.p5-master-menu{display:block!important;grid-template-columns:none!important;position:absolute;right:0;top:calc(100% + 7px);padding:10px;width:min(370px,calc(100vw - 28px));max-height:min(74vh,700px);overflow:auto;box-shadow:0 22px 65px #000a;border:1px solid rgba(189,161,124,.48);border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(29,43,55,.98),rgba(15,27,38,.99));-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);backdrop-filter:blur(20px)}
.global-dock .p5-master-menu details.master-menu-section{min-width:0;width:100%;margin:0;background:none;border:0;border-radius:0;position:static}
.global-dock .p5-master-menu .master-menu-section>summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:15px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(210,180,135,.20);color:#f2e9de;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-align:left;list-style:none}
.global-dock .p5-master-menu .master-menu-section>summary span{width:22px;flex:0 0 22px;color:#d3b88e;text-align:center;font-size:16px}
.global-dock .p5-master-menu .master-menu-section>summary b{margin-left:auto;color:#d2b18a;transform:rotate(0deg);transition:transform .12s}
.global-dock .p5-master-menu .master-menu-section[open]>summary b{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.global-dock .p5-master-menu .menu-body{padding:5px 11px 11px 36px;background:rgba(13,25,36,.39)}
